extracted.intended_audience: general adult internet readers who enjoy short jokes and listicles
extracted.subtask_description: Assembling a numbered BuzzFeed-style listicle of short jokes aimed at adults, sourced from online communities and user submissions. The page collects one-liners, short anecdotes, and user handles/images with editorial updates.

rubrics_metrics.name: Target audience: adults
rubrics_metrics.description: Page title: 'People Are Sharing The Funniest Jokes For Adults' — the collection is explicitly aimed at an adult audience.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Content includes mature/sexual/edgy material; readers and submitters should expect adult-themed jokes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Source attribution / sourcing
rubrics_metrics.description: The post states jokes were 'sourced from r/jokes and this Quora thread'. Many entries include the submitting username or credit line after the joke.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When curating, attribute jokes to their original submitters (Reddit/Quora handles shown). Maintain a visible source line for each joke when available.

rubrics_metrics.name: Submission method and credit instruction
rubrics_metrics.description: Copy from page: 'Got a joke that cracks you up? Let us know in the comments or by using the anonymous form below and it could be featured in a future BuzzFeed post!'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If using the anonymous form but wanting credit, 'just put your name in under the joke!' — editorial workflow accepts comments or anonymous submissions and allows optional crediting.

rubrics_metrics.name: Format: numbered list of short jokes (one-liners/short anecdotes)
rubrics_metrics.description: The post is organized as a numbered list (1–60) where each item is a concise joke—one-liners, short anecdotes, or brief setups/punchlines.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Entries are short and self-contained; occasional images are used between items and user handles are appended. Keep items brief and punchy for listicle readability.

rubrics_metrics.name: Tone and permissible content
rubrics_metrics.description: Jokes on the page include sexual themes, bodily-function humor, dark humor, and jokes referencing social groups (e.g., 'incels').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Editorially the list includes edgy and potentially offensive material consistent with 'adult' labeling; curators should be aware of potential sensitivity and community standards but the page does not present formal content restrictions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Editorial maintenance / update attribution
rubrics_metrics.description: The page notes: 'This post has been updated by Kaitlin Stevens and Brittany Miranda.'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Listicles may be updated over time by staff editors; maintain a visible update history/attribution for edits.
